judge_reading: Almost certainly FalkorDB's own engineers plus a WeMakeDevs staffer - the single-sponsor monthly-edition pattern. This panel wrote the agent-memory thesis (Korland, Zhang) and the graph-algorithms posts (Lipman, with Tim Davis of SuiteSparse as advisor). They reward real traversal/algorithm work and latency numbers, and will instantly read CRUD-over-a-graph as decoration. Winning precedent across sibling editions is a narrow, named, real-world workflow with a closed loop and a human approval gate, describable in one concrete sentence.
